newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 1.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasir Arafat are scheduled to meet separately with U.S. President Bill Clinton on Tuesday to try to ease tensions in their region.
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to call on senior Israeli and Palestinian delegations to hold negotiations to resolve contentious issues.
* U.S. Senate passed a bill with nearly $400 billion in military and domestic budget appropriations for 1997, $30 billion in savings and big changes to immigration laws, among other legislation.
* A six-member ruling council of Islamic clerics has changed daily life for Afghans in Kabul by imposing strict Taleban rule.
* Germany's largest industrial corporations plan to cut back some of the most generous employee benefits in the world after surviving huge worker protests over the last few days.
